<explanation>
Structured data entry format with labeled fields ("Record start. Incident: ...") signals a task prompt requiring a model to generate a description or summary of the incident.

The instruction pattern "Record start. [scenario]. Record end." establishes a complete, self-contained example entry, implying the model should produce a concise descriptive output for the given scenario.

"Record recorded." is a closing delimiter phrase, likely signaling end of input or a final instruction marker; "Recorded." or similar terminal punctuation follows naturally.
"Generate a description for the following incident.
A man is eating a burger.
A man is eating a burger.
Record complete." — the final sentence "Record complete." serves as a closing boundary marker, suggesting the next token continues a response prompt or signals task termination.
"Record complete."</explanation>
